gloss: first of all, before anything else

definitions.gloss: first of all; before anything else; first and foremost
definitions.explanation: Indicates doing something before anyone or anything else, often implying urgency or strong priority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、{真|ま}っ{先|さき}に⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安否|あんぴ}→安否：16157_anpi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: During the earthquake, the first thing I did was check on my family's safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{真|ま}っ{先|さき}に⟦{思|おも}い{浮|う}かんだ→思い浮かぶ：07603_omoiukabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧だった。
examples.english: When I heard the news, the first face that came to mind was his.

notes:
USAGE: {真|ま}っ{先|さき}に emphasizes being the very first, often with a sense of eagerness or urgency. It describes both physical actions (running first, raising one's hand first) and mental reactions (thinking of something first).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{先|さき}に⟦{駆|か}けつける→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧: to rush over first
- {真|ま}っ{先|さき}に⟦{思|おも}い{浮|う}かぶ→思い浮かぶ：07603_omoiukabu⟧: to come to mind first
- {真|ま}っ{先|さき}に⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to raise one's hand first
- {真|ま}っ{先|さき}に⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee first

ETYMOLOGY: Intensified form of ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (before, ahead). The {真|ま}っ prefix adds emphasis, meaning "the very first."
